title: Charge discarded successful bonds when rooted-prefix retries erase downstream islands
statement: For L>=1 edges, independent per-round per-edge correct probability0<p<=1, no wrong bonds or damage, perfect removal of every unrooted island and unchanged rooted register, R=1+NegBin(L,p) counts failures before L frontier successes. E[R]=1+L*(1-p)/p and E[discarded successful downstream bonds]=(1-p)*L*(L-1)/2. Independently rooted b-edge packets with b dividing L reduce only within-packet waste to(1-p)*L*(b-1)/2.

requires: Perfect full-island clearance, retained original rooted register, independent identical edge opportunities, no permanent wrong link/damage, and all unresolved downstream edges attempted each round.
provides: For L>=1 edges, independent per-round per-edge correct probability0<p<=1, no wrong bonds or damage, perfect removal of every unrooted island and unchanged rooted register, R=1+NegBin(L,p) counts failures before L frontier successes. E[R]=1+L*(1-p)/p and E[discarded successful downstream bonds]=(1-p)*L*(L-1)/2. Independently rooted b-edge packets with b dividing L reduce only within-packet waste to(1-p)*L*(b-1)/2.
assumptions: Incomplete clearance, source exhaustion, register changes and damaged roots violate the renewal. Packet roots/fusion are additional unacquired operations.
costs: Count all formed then discarded correct links, rounds, donor refill and reset. Round counts alone are not total physical time or material/energy usage.
contract.units: L,b,R and wasted links are counts; p is dimensionless; no conversion to measured material/time is supplied.
contract.obstruction: Qualify real reset and packet fusion instead of assuming that a small modeled waste count supplies them.

body: Read each round until its first missing frontier edge; the retained prefix crosses L successes and each failure starts another round, giving the negative-binomial law and Var[R]=L*(1-p)/p^2. For each ordered pair i<j, frontier i fails on average(1-p)/p times before crossing; later j independently succeeds with probability p in each such erased round. Thus each pair contributes1-p wasted correct links. Sum all pairs. Retaining disconnected islands instead has completion law[1-(1-p)^r]^L after r rounds under its own ideal model. Packetting assumes independent roots and excludes fusion/root removal; rooted continuity also cannot screen a stable wrong link or infer order from mass/end labels.

evidence.range_scope: Ideal rooted-prefix renewal and quadratic discarded-correct-link waste; within-packet reduction excludes fusion.
